providerOperator: Obolos reference provider; not an independent third-party seller

checks.label: Source attribution
checks.detail: Every record points to its exact GitHub API source.

checks.label: Valid observed counts
checks.detail: Stars, forks and issue counts are non-negative integers.

checks.label: Observation timestamps
checks.detail: Each observation includes fetch and last-push timestamps.

checks.label: Metrics: octocat/Hello-World
checks.detail: Exactly one stars, forks and openIssues row must match the submitted evidence.

checks.label: Evidence integrity and freshness
checks.detail: Unique GitHub evidence must be at most one hour old; its provenance is checked separately by paid delivery.

checks.label: Claim scope
checks.detail: Only canonical metric rows are certified against evidence. Free-text judgments are not certified; extra numeric metric claims are rejected.

checks.label: Example provider: repository identity
checks.detail: This independent HTTP provider checked repository identities in the paid evidence.
